notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
